summary: The contact page has to make it easy to reach the shop. It offers a form, phone, fax, email and the address, but the phone number and email are plain text (no tap to call), opening hours are missing here, and the form is a fixed-width table. Most important: tap-to-call, email and the shop's hours in the first screen on a phone.
audience: Customers with a question about a product or an order.
tasks: Send a question about an order

purpose.clear.evidence: Heading „Contact Us“ and the first sentence.

purpose.tasks.evidence: Calling needs copying the number: „Telephone: 01632 960 412“ is plain text, as is the email.

content.complete.evidence: Opening hours of the phone line are there, the shop's opening hours and a map link are not.

content.current.evidence: A fax number („01632 960 413“) as a main contact option.

structure.scannable.evidence: The form comes first; phone and email are below it under „Other ways to contact us“.

action.primary.evidence: The form's „Send message“ sits next to „Clear“, which wipes the form.

nav.menu.evidence: Seven green tabs (Home … Sale!) plus a second department list in the sidebar; the current tab is marked yellow, but Delivery, Returns and Contact live only in the footer.

visual.brand.evidence: The green house-and-leaf logo with the italic Millbrook wordmark, dark green #2f5420 / #4c7f2f and cream surfaces: recognisable on every page and fitting for a home and garden shop. Verdana 11 px is just old, not brand.

visual.hierarchy.evidence: Form, phone and address have the same weight.

visual.consistency.evidence: Same frame, nav, sidebar boxes and footer as the other pages.

trust.signals.evidence: Full address, phone and email on the page.

inventory.why: Phone-friendly form without the Clear button.
Tap-to-call and mailto links first; drop the fax.
With opening hours and a map link.

fix.text: Phone and email are not links

add: Shop opening hours and a map link
design_input: Call, email and visit as three cards at the top
